title: Spike: keyring backends and non-interactive reads, WSL store survival (gates D2/D10), op service-account ratelimit under a token, --expires-in 90d, service-account count limit
acceptance: Each of the 7 items in design §15 is marked verified, refuted or still unknown, with evidence
A recommendation for the WSL store (persistent or volatile) that decides whether S19 exists
No value or token appears in the findings

title: Domain: Principal::Agent, agent_account() naming, CiReader-equal grants, AgentRecord index type
acceptance: agent_account(project, env, machine) == '{project}-{env}-agent-{machine}', machine sanitized to [a-z0-9-] and at most 32 characters
Principal::Agent grants equal CiReader's: read only, boundary vaults only
AgentRecord serializes with no value or digest field

title: Causes and codes: agent_identity_not_installed, agent_identity_exists, agent_rejected, agent_store_unavailable, agent_store_locked, agent_store_volatile
acceptance: Each code has a category, exit code, retry, human_required and a typed next with actor person
No next suggests OPV_IDENTITY=person; a person-only refusal says to run the command in your own terminal
A rejected service-account token under the agent identity is diagnosed as agent_rejected

title: Credential-store adapter: AgentCredentialSource trait, fake, OS-store source on the backends S1 chose, non-interactive 5-second reads
acceptance: The trait has resolve, describe and preflight; resolve returns a SecretValue registered with the scrubber
A read never prompts: a locked store or one that would prompt gives agent_store_locked within 5 s
No usable store gives agent_store_unavailable; there is no file fallback
A volatile backend is reported as volatile in describe()

title: Selection rules 1-3 resolved once per process; OpCredential::Agent; stop without fallback
acceptance: An env token wins (rule 1); OPV_IDENTITY=person gives the person (rule 2); OPV_IDENTITY=agent gives the agent identity (rule 3)
OPV_IDENTITY=agent with no identity for an environment stops with agent_identity_not_installed and never uses a person session
Resolved once, before the first op call; Host::detect() reports op_credential = Agent afterwards

title: Runner: token on captured calls (token_only) and on inherited op run (vet R1)
acceptance: Each captured op call under the agent identity carries OP_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_TOKEN only in its own env and takes token_only
Inherited op run: OP_SESSION*, OP_CONNECT_* and OP_ACCOUNT removed, add_op_session skipped, OP_BIOMETRIC_UNLOCK_ENABLED=false and OP_CACHE=false, env not cleared
Non-op children never get the token

title: Refusal unification, sync refused under the agent, write-path matrix
acceptance: Every one of the 12 require_person callers refuses with own_session_required under the agent identity before any op write
opv_import_local and provision use the selected identity, not environment variables only
opv sync under the agent identity is refused before any call, and Next says your own terminal or CI's deploy job

title: --create --agent: Destination split, binding check, store, index, production --confirm, clap flags for create and rotate, person_only
acceptance: Create requests read_items on exactly the CiReader vaults, --expires-in 90d, no --can-create-vaults
The binding check (whoami account UUID, vault set) runs on every create; on a mismatch nothing is stored and the person is told to remove the account
A production-tier environment without --confirm <env> is refused before the prompt
Output matches design §7.2 and ends with Next: opv doctor --env <env>; no token in the output
--agent conflicts with --github, --target and --grant-receipt; refused under agent markers

title: --rotate --agent for one identity or all on the machine; #324 marker per identity
acceptance: Without an env it rotates every indexed identity on this machine; one Do: line names every old account
The old token is replaced only after the successor passes the token-scoped check
An interrupted rotation refuses that identity with secret_not_stored and --revoked, and goes on with the others
A production identity without --confirm is skipped with a note

title: Doctor op identity row: states, reach, expiry, rate limit, store states
acceptance: Every state in design §7.4 renders as text and JSON (check op_identity)
reads N of M vaults from a token-scoped op vault list; never claims writes none
An unreadable ratelimit omits the figure and never fails the row
agent_store_volatile and agent_store_locked are FAIL rows

title: ready identity object, FR-69 agent expiry, schema and JSON (MCP follows)
acceptance: ready --json carries identity per environment with kind, name, source, read_only, expires_on, reach, rate_limit and state
Agent expiry within 14 days is credential_expiring; it stays advisory and never fails --gate
opv_state ready and accounts carry the same object; no new MCP tool or section
The schema and surface contract are updated

title: opv-sim service accounts for agents; e2e with token and value canaries, op run env, plan/status causes
acceptance: A fake token and fake values never appear in stdout, stderr, --json or MCP across create, run, plan, ready, status, doctor and rotate
op run's environment under the agent identity has the token and no OP_SESSION*, OP_CONNECT_* or OP_ACCOUNT; the app's environment has no OP_*
plan and status causes under reader grants are pinned in snapshots
The coverage gate passes (new calls faulted or listed in SKIPPED.md)

title: Docs for agents: setup guide, skill, llms
acceptance: The four-identity table, the person's one command, OPV_IDENTITY=agent, and §4.6's residual word for word, with optional hardening
No OP_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_TOKEN= export in the agent docs; never suggests OPV_IDENTITY=person or an agent sync

title: Docs for people: usage, README, MCP, configuration, FR-71, changelog
acceptance: usage has an Agent identities section matching §7; FR-71 added; FR-11 and SR-5 name the agent identity
Every documented command parses with the built opv

title: Release gate: cargo test, clippy, e2e with CI=true
acceptance: The full test suite, clippy and e2e pass locally and with CI=true

title: Owner step: real agent identity on WSL; opv run dev -- cargo test from an assistant with OPV_IDENTITY=agent; env shows no token
acceptance: The owner confirms the run worked unattended and env showed no token

title: Rule 4: auto-select in agent mode; once one identity is installed for the account and project, an environment without one stops
acceptance: An agent marker plus any installed identity selects the agent identity
A multi-env ready under a marker never uses the person session for an environment without an identity: it reports agent_identity_not_installed for that environment

title: --remove --agent: delete the store and index entries; Do: revoke
acceptance: The store entry and index entry are removed; Do: names the account to revoke; person only

title: Only if S1 finds the WSL store volatile: Private-vault durable copy and --install --agent
acceptance: Create also writes the token to the person's Private vault on op item create stdin
--install reloads the working copy with one person approval and checks it

title: opv-site pages (design §9)
acceptance: The site shows the four-identity model, the one command and the residual
